summary: Feed c045_crc to APM is degraded due to high physical-layer errors on VF-1 port 3 input: 14,100 CRC/alignment damaged frames (0.324% error rate vs 1e-05 threshold). Corrupted traffic will be dropped before APM analysis, reducing coverage until link is repaired.

findings.root_cause: VF-1 port 3 (input) received 14,100 damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors (metric 0.003241 vs threshold 1e-05), indicating a faulty cable, optic, or duplex mismatch on the link into VF-1.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will drop corrupted frames, causing incomplete transactions, missing request/response pairs, and inaccurate latency/error metrics. APM needs both directions and cannot correctly measure performance on damaged/incomplete flows.

recommended_fix.why: Physical layer corruption cannot be fixed by packet broker policy; the faulty cable/optic/duplex on VF-1 port 3 must be inspected, reseated/replaced, and autonegotiation verified, then counters cleared to confirm error rate drops below threshold before APM coverage can be trusted.
